title: Shield investors launch Macquarie class action

Editor's Choice
Shield investors launch Macquarie class action
Gordan Legal commenced a class action against Macquarie Investment Management, alleging the investors in the collapsed Shield Master Fund have not been fully compensated for losses affecting their retirement savings.
Sequoia plots potential restructure
Sequoia Financial Group, the parent company of InterPrac Financial Planning, is conducting a thorough review of all its operating subsidiaries for a potential restructuring.
Australia's family offices surpass $323bn in assets
Family offices in Australia have surpassed $323 billion in assets, according to data from Rainmaker Information.
Guardians names head of portfolio completion
The Guardians of New Zealand Superannuation has appointed a new head of portfolio completion who hails from QIC's liquid markets team.
